pattern: SELECT .* FROM concert JOIN .* ON concert\.concert\_ID = .*\.concert\_ID WHERE YEAR\(concert\.Year\) = \d{4}\)
correction: Use EXCEPT or MINUS operator to find the difference between the set of all stadium names and the set of stadium names that hosted concerts in the year 2014.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that incorrectly join tables to find stadiums without concerts in a specific year, and suggests using the EXCEPT or MINUS operator to correctly find the difference between all stadium names and the names of those that hosted concerts.
